<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram id="2V55d9amPjtdCaID53C_" name="Page-1"> <mxGraphModel dx="1684" dy="893" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="1"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "erDiagram
%% ER Diagram - Django app \"books\" (source of truth: books/models.py)
%% Physical/DB-level view: the ManyToMany is shown as its auto-created through table.
%%
%% Line type: \"..\" = non-identifying (all tables use a surrogate PK \"id\";
%% no FK participates in a primary key, so no relationship is identifying).
%%
%% Table-level constraints (Mermaid has no native notation for these):
%% BOOK : CHECK \"book_price_non_negative\" -> price >= 0 OR price IS NULL
%% BOOK_CATEGORIES : UNIQUE (book_id, category_id) [Django auto M2M table books_book_categories]
%% FAVORITE : UNIQUE \"unique_user_book_favorite\" -> (user_id, book_id)
%% FAVORITE : Meta.ordering = (\"-created_at\",) [not a DB constraint]
%% FK delete rules : BOOK_CATEGORIES.book_id CASCADE, BOOK_CATEGORIES.category_id CASCADE,
%% FAVORITE.user_id CASCADE, FAVORITE.book_id CASCADE

 AUTH_USER {
 int id PK
 varchar username UK
 varchar password
 varchar email
 varchar first_name
 varchar last_name
 boolean is_staff
 boolean is_superuser
 boolean is_active
 datetime last_login
 datetime date_joined
 }

 CATEGORY {
 int id PK
 varchar name UK
 }

 BOOK {
 int id PK
 varchar title
 varchar author
 varchar isbn UK
 smallint publication_year
 date publication_date
 decimal price
 text description
 boolean is_available
 datetime created_at
 datetime updated_at
 }

 BOOK_CATEGORIES {
 int id PK
 int book_id FK
 int category_id FK
 }

 FAVORITE {
 int id PK
 int user_id FK
 int book_id FK
 datetime created_at
 }

 BOOK ||..o{ BOOK_CATEGORIES : \"categories\"
 CATEGORY ||..o{ BOOK_CATEGORIES : \"books\"
 AUTH_USER ||..o{ FAVORITE : \"favorites\"
 BOOK ||..o{ FAVORITE : \"favorited_by\"",
 "config": null
